"""Private N5 probe: build nondispersive layer matrices once per spectrum."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))
from studies.rcwa.nvf_fitting_grid.nvf_fitting_grid import TRUE, WAVELENGTHS, problem
from wavebit import rcwa
from wavebit.rcwa._lifecycle import _runtime_checks
from wavebit.rcwa.results import pack

jax.config.update('jax_enable_x64', True)


def build(grid):
    concrete = problem(TRUE, 800., (1., 0.))
    prepared = rcwa.prepare(concrete, numerics=rcwa.Numerics(
        orders=(4, 4), shape_nvf_grid_size=grid, topology_check='host'), backend='jax')
    prepared.report.raise_if_invalid()
    wavelengths = jnp.asarray(np.tile(WAVELENGTHS, 2))
    polarizations = jnp.asarray(np.repeat(np.eye(2), len(WAVELENGTHS), axis=0))

    def values(q):
        with prepared.execution._scope():
            geometry_solver = prepared._solvers(problem(q, 800., (1., 0.)))[0]
            matrices = geometry_solver.eps_conv_matrices(geometry=prepared._geometry[0])

            def lane(wavelength, jones):
                p = problem(q, wavelength, (jones[0], jones[1]))
                solver = prepared._solvers(p)[0]
                checks = _runtime_checks(p, prepared.execution, prepared._partitions)
                checks.update(prepared._topology_checks(p))
                solved = solver.solve_conv(*matrices)
                result = pack(p, prepared.numerics, prepared.execution, [(solver, solved)],
                              checks, prepared.report)
                flags = jnp.stack([jnp.all(v) for v in result.validity.checks.values()])
                return jnp.real(result.reflection.order(0, 0).efficiency)[0], jnp.all(flags)

            y, valid = jax.vmap(lane)(wavelengths, polarizations)
        return y, (y, valid)

    return jax.jit(jax.jacfwd(values, has_aux=True)), jax.jit(values)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('--grid', type=int, required=True)
    ap.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
    ap.add_argument('--reference', type=Path)
    ap.add_argument('--fd', action='store_true')
    args = ap.parse_args()
    assert not args.output.exists()
    start = time.monotonic()
    full, values = build(args.grid)
    jac, (y, valid) = full(jnp.asarray(TRUE))
    y, jac, valid = np.asarray(y), np.asarray(jac), np.asarray(valid)
    assert valid.all() and np.isfinite(y).all() and np.isfinite(jac).all()
    report = dict(completed=False, grid=args.grid, parameters=TRUE.tolist(),
                  values=y.tolist(), jacobian=jac.tolist(), seconds=time.monotonic()-start,
                  instrument_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                  scope='Nondispersive N5 only; geometry matrices shared inside full AD.')
    if args.reference:
        ref = json.loads(args.reference.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        a, c = np.asarray(ref['values']), np.asarray(ref['jacobian'])
        np.testing.assert_allclose(y, a, rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-12)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(jac, c, rtol=1e-8, atol=1e-11)
        report['reference_max_value_error'] = float(abs(y-a).max())
        report['reference_column_relative'] = (abs(jac-c).max(0)/abs(c).max(0)).tolist()
    print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in report.items() if k not in ('values','jacobian')}, indent=2), flush=True)
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
    if args.fd:
        columns = []
        for axis, h in enumerate([.01, .0001, .01, .01]):
            central = []
            for step in [h, h/2]:
                delta = np.zeros(4); delta[axis] = step
                sides = []
                for sign in [1, -1]:
                    out, (_, ok) = values(jnp.asarray(TRUE+sign*delta))
                    assert np.asarray(ok).all()
                    sides.append(np.asarray(out))
                central.append((sides[0]-sides[1])/(2*step))
            richardson = (4*central[1]-central[0])/3
            error = float(abs(richardson-jac[:,axis]).max()/abs(jac[:,axis]).max())
            columns.append(dict(axis=axis,relative_error=error))
            print('FD',axis,error,flush=True)
        report['fd'] = columns
    report['completed'] = True
    report['total_seconds'] = time.monotonic()-start
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
    print('completed',report['total_seconds'],flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Check a retained N5 Jacobian with fresh, value-only central differences."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import time

import numpy as np

from studies.rcwa.nvf_fitting_grid.nvf_fitting_grid import TRUE
from studies.rcwa.nvf_fitting_grid.shared_matrix_model import SharedMatrixModel

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--reference', type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
assert not args.output.exists()
reference = json.loads(args.reference.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert reference['completed'] and reference['parameters'] == TRUE.tolist()
model = SharedMatrixModel(reference['grid'])
jacobian = np.asarray(reference['jacobian'])
record = dict(completed=False, grid=reference['grid'], parameters=TRUE.tolist(),
              reference_sha256=hashlib.sha256(args.reference.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              instrument_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              solver_revision='98353d8ecebd5ae45d563b11083c9ed3c761644d',
              criterion=1e-3, columns=[])
root = Path.cwd()
record['source_sha256'] = {name: hashlib.sha256((root / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    for name in ['studies/rcwa/nvf_fitting_grid/shared_matrix_model.py',
                 'studies/rcwa/nvf_fitting_grid/nvf_fitting_grid.py']}
start = time.monotonic()
for axis, h in enumerate([.01, .0001, .01, .01]):
    central = []
    for step in [h, h / 2]:
        delta = np.zeros(4)
        delta[axis] = step
        central.append((model(TRUE + delta, derivative=False)
                        - model(TRUE - delta, derivative=False)) / (2 * step))
    richardson = (4 * central[1] - central[0]) / 3
    error = float(np.max(np.abs(richardson - jacobian[:, axis]))
                  / np.max(np.abs(jacobian[:, axis])))
    record['columns'].append(dict(axis=axis, step=h, central=central[0].tolist(),
        central_half=central[1].tolist(), richardson=richardson.tolist(),
        relative_max=error, passed=error <= 1e-3))
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    print('FD', axis, error, flush=True)
record.update(completed=True, total_seconds=time.monotonic() - start,
              passed=all(c['passed'] for c in record['columns']))
args.output.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print('completed', record['passed'], record['total_seconds'], flush=True)

"""Compare single-direction and full-forward AD at the same fine N5 grid."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import time

import jax.numpy as jnp
import numpy as np

from studies.rcwa.nvf_fitting_grid.nvf_fitting_grid import TRUE
from studies.rcwa.nvf_fitting_grid.shared_matrix_model import SharedMatrixModel

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--reference', type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
assert not args.output.exists()
reference = json.loads(args.reference.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert reference['completed'] and reference['parameters'] == TRUE.tolist()
start = time.monotonic()
model = SharedMatrixModel(reference['grid'], sequential_jvp=True)
model._prepare(TRUE)
column, (values, valid) = model.compiled(jnp.asarray(TRUE), jnp.array([0., 1., 0., 0.]))
column, values = np.asarray(column), np.asarray(values)
assert np.asarray(valid).all() and np.isfinite(column).all() and np.isfinite(values).all()
expected = np.asarray(reference['jacobian'])[:, 1]
np.testing.assert_allclose(values, reference['values'], rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-12)
np.testing.assert_allclose(column, expected, rtol=1e-8, atol=1e-11)
record = dict(completed=True, passed=True, grid=reference['grid'], axis=1,
              solver_revision='98353d8ecebd5ae45d563b11083c9ed3c761644d',
              public_model_revision='904316c11e8197303043981d7cf3522d59d94a03',
              reference_sha256=hashlib.sha256(args.reference.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              instrument_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              values=values.tolist(), angle_column=column.tolist(),
              value_max_difference=float(np.max(np.abs(values-reference['values']))),
              column_relative_difference=float(np.max(np.abs(column-expected))/np.max(np.abs(expected))),
              seconds=time.monotonic()-start)
args.output.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in record.items() if k not in ['values', 'angle_column']}, indent=2), flush=True)
